original: karmeti saṃbhāranibandhanaṃ dhyānādhyayanādikam | āpa(19r)dyata āpadi | tasmin karmaṇi vyasanī prasaktaḥ | tatkarmaśauṇḍas tasmin karmaṇi pravṛttilampaṭaḥ | dyūtādikrīḍāyāṃ yat phalaṃ sukhaṃ tadīpsur iva || [7.63] ity api karmaṇi ratir āsevitavyety āha sukhārtham iti | na cāniṣphalasyāpy ārambhasya saṃbhavāt | tathāpi karmaṇo na nivartate lokaḥ |
analyzed: karma iti saṃbhāra nibandhanam dhyāna adhyayana ādikam āpa ardyate āpadi tasmin karmaṇi vyasanī prasaktaḥ tad karma śauṇḍaḥ tasmin karmaṇi pravṛtti lampaṭaḥ dyūta ādi krīḍāyām yat phalam sukham tat īpsuḥ iva iti api karmaṇi ratiḥ āsevitavyā iti āha sukha artham iti na ca a niṣphalasya api ārambhasya saṃbhavāt tathā api karmaṇaḥ na nivartate lokaḥ

original: kasmai ca dhyānādhyayana rūpam | [7.64] idam api cintayatā puṇyakarmaṇy abhirantavyam ity āha kāmair iti rūpādibhiḥ | kṣuradhārālagnamadhūpabhoge tṛṣṇākṛte yathā jihvāchedaduḥkhaṃ tathā kāmair apy upabhuktair jātyādiduḥkham iti tadupamaiḥ | vipāke pariṇatau svargādiphalatvān madhuraiḥ | niḥśreyasā vāhakatayājarāmaratvahetutvāc chivaiḥ |
analyzed: kasmai ca dhyāna adhyayana rūpam idam api cintayatā puṇya karmaṇi abhirantavyam iti āha kāmaiḥ iti rūpa ādibhiḥ kṣura dhārā lagna madhu upabhoge tṛṣṇā kṛte yathā jihvā cheda duḥkham tathā kāmaiḥ api upabhuktaiḥ jāti ādi duḥkham iti tad upamaiḥ vipāke pariṇatau svarga ādi phala tvāt madhuraiḥ niḥśreyasā vāhaka tayā ajara amara tva hetu tvāt śivaiḥ

original: ata eva puṇyāmṛtair ity uktam || [7.65] tasmād iti karmaṇi ratim evopasaṃhāravyājena draḍhaya(19v)ti | avasānaṃ visarjanasamayaḥ | prāptasarāḥ karīti bahuvrīhigarbhaḥ karmadhārayaḥ || [7.66] muktibalam āha baleti | prārabdhakāryanirvartanaśaktikṣamasyānubandhe prabandhe nānugamena tu kṣaṇamātraṃ nāśe |

original: paścāt kariṣyāmīty abhiprāyas tāvatkālaṃ muñcet | susamāptaṃ ca yat tad api tyajed aparaviśeṣāpekṣayā | tatra niṣpanne prayatnānupayogāt | ayaṃ ca pūrvaṃ nirūpya sāmagrīm ityāder apavādaḥ || [7.67] balavyūhaṃ sākalyenābhidhāyāviṣādeti prathamam uddiṣṭam api punaś chandādigaṇe ’vaśyakartavyatayā kathitaṃ tātparyaṃ tāvad āha kleśeti |
analyzed: paścāt kariṣyāmi iti abhiprāyaḥ tāvatkālam muñcet su samāptam ca yat tat api tyajet apara viśeṣa apekṣayā tatra niṣpanne prayatna anupayogāt ayam ca pūrvam nirūpya sāmagrīm ityādeḥ apavādaḥ balavyūham sākalyena abhidhāya aviṣāda iti prathamam uddiṣṭam api punar chanda ādi gaṇe vaśya kartavyatayā kathitam tātparyam tāvat āha kleśa iti

original: saṃrakṣan nivārayan | dṛḍhaṃ punaranavakāśena | [7.68] punas tātparyaṃ śikṣayati tatreti | khaḍgaṃ yuddhe | bhraṣṭaṃ smṛtisaṃpramoṣe | skhalite sati smaran | [7.69] nanu sūkṣmadoṣo ’pi kiṃ nopekṣyata i(20r)ty āha viṣam iti | prasarpati prasarati | chidraṃ smṛtisaṃpramoṣarūpam | doṣo ’ṇur api | [7.70] taileti punar anyathā tātparyam āha |

original: tathā vratī bodhisattvasaṃvaravān | skhalite duḥkhatrāsāt tadanavakāśāya tatparaḥ syāt || [7.71] tasmād ity uktam upasaṃharati | pratikurvīta mukhaprakṣālanālokasaṃjñānityatābhāvanādibhiḥ pratikriyāṃ kuryāt || [7.72] tatparasyāpi skhalite karaṇīyam āha ekaikasminn iti pratyekaṃ smṛtipramoṣāt skhalite | idaṃ skhalitam ||
analyzed: tathā vratī bodhisattva saṃvaravān skhalite duḥkha trāsāt tad anavakāśāya tatparaḥ syāt tasmāt iti uktam upasaṃharati pratikurvīta mukha prakṣālana āloka saṃjñā nitya tā bhāvanā ādibhiḥ pratikriyām kuryāt tad parasya api skhalite karaṇīyam āha ekaikasmin iti pratyekam smṛti pramoṣāt skhalite idam skhalitam

original: [7.73] etena skhalitāvakāśavāraṇābhiprāyeṇa hetunā | niṣiddham api saṃsargam ekatrāvasthānaṃ bahuśrutair ācāryopādhyāyādibhiḥ | tanniśritas tiṣṭhed ity arthaḥ | karma vāvavādānuśāsanīrūpam | skhalite daṇḍakarmasvabhāvaṃ vā prāptam āpatitam | kathaṃ nāmeti lokoktyāśaṃsāyām | (20v) āsu kleśāvatāradaśāsu | uktaṃ ca | upādhyāyānuśāsanyetyādi ||
analyzed: etena skhalita avakāśa vāraṇa abhiprāyeṇa hetunā niṣiddham api saṃsargam ekatra avasthānam bahuśrutaiḥ ācārya upādhyāya ādibhiḥ tad niśritaḥ tiṣṭhet iti arthaḥ karma skhalite daṇḍa karma svabhāvam vā prāptam āpatitam katham nāma iti loka ukti āśaṃsāyām āsu kleśa avatāra daśāsu uktam ca upādhyāya anuśāsanyā ityādi

original: [7.74] ātmavidheyatām āha laghū kuryād iti | laghuḥ śīghrakārī | ātmā pañcaskandharūpaḥ | tathā utsāhābhyāsāt | apramādaḥ kuśaleṣv avadhānam | tatkathāpramādo ’mṛtapadam ityādikā | karmārambhāt prāg eva yathā sajjaḥ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāraḥ syāt sudāntāśvavat | [7.75] uktam evārtham udāharaṇena spaṣṭayati yathaiveti | gatyāgatyor vāyor āyattam |
analyzed: ātma vidheyatām āha laghū kuryāt iti laghuḥ śīghrakārī ātmā pañca skandha rūpaḥ tathā utsāha abhyāsāt apramādaḥ kuśaleṣu avadhānam tad kathā apramādaḥ mṛta padam iti ādikā karma ārambhāt prāk eva yathā sajjaḥ saṃbhṛta saṃbhāraḥ syāt su dānta aśva vat uktam eva artham udāharaṇena spaṣṭayati yathā eva iti gati āgatyoḥ vāyoḥ āyattam

original: [8.1–2] vikṣiptacitto yasmāt kleśānāṃ rakṣasām iva daṃṣṭrā madhye sthitaḥ samādhivipakṣavikṣepanirākaraṇaṃ prastauti kāyeti | vitarkān janapadādigocarān | (21r) upalakṣaṇatvāt kāmachandādīn api | [8.3] tatra lokāparityāgahetuṃ tāvad āha snehād iti | sneho ’bhiṣvaṅgaḥ | lābhasatkārayaśaḥprabhṛtiṣu ca tarṣeṇa |
analyzed: vikṣipta cittaḥ yasmāt kleśānām rakṣasām iva daṃṣṭrāḥ madhye sthitaḥ samādhi vipakṣa vikṣepa nirākaraṇam prastauti kāya iti vitarkān janapada ādi gocarān upalakṣaṇa tvāt kāmachanda ādīn api tatra loka aparityāga hetum tāvat āha snehāt iti snehaḥ bhiṣvaṅgaḥ lābha satkāra yaśaḥ prabhṛtiṣu ca tarṣeṇa

original: etasya snehasya lābhāditṛṣṇāyāś ca lokasya cāparityāganimittam | [8.4] śamathena hetunā vipaśyanayā suṣṭhu yuktaḥ samāhita citto yathābhūtaṃ prajānātīty ukteḥ | sarvaloke nirapekṣayānapekṣayābhiratyānabhiratyeti yāvat | [8.5] tam evānabhirati āha kasyeti | anityeṣu putrakalatrādiṣu | kena hetunā | yeneti || prīṇātīti ca priyaḥ |
analyzed: etasya snehasya lābha ādi tṛṣṇāyāḥ ca lokasya ca a parityāga nimittam śamathena hetunā vipaśyanayā suṣṭhu yuktaḥ samāhita cittaḥ yathābhūtam prajānāti iti ukteḥ sarva loke nirapekṣayā anapekṣayā abhiratyā anabhiratyā iti yāvat tam eva anabhirati āha kasya iti anityeṣu putra kalatra ādiṣu kena hetunā yena iti prīṇāti iti ca priyaḥ

original: [8.6] tattvam apy asya nāstīty āha apaśyann iti | ratir dhṛtiḥ | pūrvavad darśanakāla iva || [8.7] aparam api doṣam āha na paśyati na jānāty aviparītadoṣaguṇān | (21v) tenaiva mohena priyasaṅgamakāṅkṣayā saṃvegād bhraśyati | tena mohenaiva kṣaṇam api viyoge yaḥ śokas tena dahyate |
analyzed: tattvam api asya na asti iti āha apaśyan iti ratiḥ dhṛtiḥ pūrvavat darśana kāle iva aparam api doṣam āha na paśyati na jānāti aviparīta doṣa guṇān tena eva mohena priya saṅgama kāṅkṣayā saṃvegāt bhraśyati tena mohena eva kṣaṇam api viyoge yaḥ śokaḥ tena dahyate

original: [8.8] tasya priyasya tatsaṅgamasya ca katham ayam avicchedī syād ityādi cintayā | dharmaḥ puṇyaṃ śāśvataḥ saṃbhārāntargamāt || [8.9] śāśvatadharmavināśam eva bālair ityādinā samarthayate | bālaiḥ pṛhagjanaiḥ | tatsadṛśa karmāvaraṇān niyataṃ durgatiḥ | neṣyate dviṣyate bālair eva | ity ubhayalokabādhanāt kiṃ hitasukhaṃ tannimittaṃ vā prāptam |
analyzed: tasya priyasya tad saṅgamasya ca katham ayam avicchedī syāt ityādi cintayā dharmaḥ puṇyam śāśvataḥ saṃbhāra antargamāt śāśvata dharma vināśam eva bālaiḥ ityādinā samarthayate bālaiḥ pṛhagjanaiḥ karma āvaraṇāt niyatam durgatiḥ neṣyate dviṣyate bālaiḥ eva iti ubhaya loka bādhanāt kim hita sukham tad nimittam vā prāptam
